entries.title: Saudi minister vows 'serious response' to Houthi attacks on airports
entries.snippet: It comes after the armed group hit Riyadh's international airport and another facility, killing 13 people, in a significant escalation.

entries.title: Indian opposition leaders march to top court to demand election chief resign
entries.snippet: The march follows a chaotic weekend in Delhi which saw thousands of protesters being detained by police.

entries.title: Pupil arrested after two teachers shot at French school

entries.title: Tom Cruise film Digger forecast to lose $245m at box office
entries.snippet: The film dropped by around 60% in its second weekend, and could become one of Hollywood's biggest flops.

entries.snippet: After analysing 1,500 videos and images of the Raila Odinga memorial, Africa Eye finds that those killed were far from the scuffles.

entries.title: Watch: Endangered orangutans released back into the wild after Borneo fires

entries.title: Iconic Australian band Powderfinger announce first tour in 17 years

entries.title: Women's billion-dollar boom leaves players behind, says Fifpro
entries.snippet: Women's football is on course to become a billion-dollar industry, but many professional players are still earning low wages, working on insecure contracts and experiencing rising psychological stress, a Fifpro survey indicates.

entries.title: Poland detains man suspected of planning assassination of PM Tusk
entries.snippet: Police received credible information about possible attacks against Donald Tusk and his defence minister.

entries.snippet: The PM was speaking after violent attacks at Polish schools this week left one dead and others injured.

entries.title: Children among 139 dead after boat capsizes off Djibouti, UN says

entries.title: Ukraine strikes Yandex data centre in third attack on Russian tech giant
entries.snippet: It is the third time this week that Ukraine has targeted Russian tech giant Yandex, forcing the company to suspend its operations.

entries.title: Pope Leo to have surgery after lump found on lung

entries.title: U.S. restrictions on Chinese drones are leaving police departments in the lurch
entries.snippet: The U.S. government is trying to end the dominance of high-quality, low-cost drones made in China. But more restrictions mean higher costs for cash-strapped police forces that rely on those drones.

entries.title: Here's what to know if you're unsure about your measles immunity status
entries.snippet: Vaccination is the best way to protect yourself against measles. For most adults, one shot of the MMR is considered enough protection. But there are certain situations that call for a second dose.

2 Americans win Nobel Prize in economics for work on boom-bust cycles
entries.snippet: Two Americans have won the Nobel Prize in economics for their work on how to smooth boom-and-bust cycles to limit unemployment and inflation.

entries.title: Trump says Russia and Ukraine agree to an 'energy ceasefire'
entries.snippet: President Trump said Sunday that Russia and Ukraine had agreed to an "energy ceasefire," but he offered no details on it and Kyiv reported attacks by Moscow on energy sites after his statement.

entries.title: Tropical Storm Rachel downgraded as high winds and rain turn inward
entries.snippet: Forecasters say the storm, which brought heavy rain and coastal flooding, is a preview of what may be in store as California braces for a possibly record-setting El Niño.

entries.title: Pope Leo XIV to undergo lung surgery this week

entries.title: Hurricane Simon pounds resorts and vulnerable towns along Mexico's Pacific coast
entries.snippet: Hurricane Simon pounded Mexico's Pacific coast as a Category 3 storm on Sunday, as its most powerful winds and rain slammed people living between the Sierra Madre and the ocean.

entries.snippet: The move escalates Trump's fight with the press amid court battle over barring CNN, Politico and MS NOW from the White House.

entries.title: Hurricane Simon hits Mexico's Pacific coast with damaging winds and rain

entries.title: Bipartisan group of senators calls on Trump to 'reverse course' on Russian diesel plan
entries.snippet: Four Republican senators and two Democratic senators signed onto the statement released Sunday in protesting the deal. They said the administration failed to consult with Congress or submit any explanation to justify its decision as required by statute.

entries.title: Riyadh airport hit by projectile a day after deadly missile strike
entries.snippet: The latest strike in Riyadh came shortly after the Houthis said the airport in the rebel-held Yemeni capital of Sanaa had been struck again, and blamed the Saudis.

entries.title: Leaders from India's 'Cockroach' movement released from detention, pledge to hold more protests
entries.snippet: The protests were triggered after authorities removed more than 130 million voters from the list since last year. Critics say the move is politically motivated. Prime Minister Narendra Modi's ruling Bharatiya Janata Party and the Election Commission deny manipulation allegations.

entries.title: Pope Leo to undergo surgery to remove nodule on his lung
entries.snippet: The 71-year-old Leo said the nodule was found at an early stage and was "circumscribed" or small and well-localized. The Vatican said Leo's expected recovery time from surgery would be a week.

entries.title: At least 139 migrants dead, dozens missing after boat capsizes off Djibouti coast
entries.snippet: The boat was traveling from Djibouti to Yemen when it capsized on Thursday night or Friday morning, according to the IOM. More than 80 people survived, all of them Ethiopian nationals, it said.

entries.title: Trump strikes deal with Putin for Russian diesel in sharp reversal of U.S. policy ahead of midterms
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump said he has struck a deal to obtain diesel from Russia, a stunning reversal of years of U.S. pressure on Moscow over its war with Ukraine and an attempt to address high fuel prices ahead of the U.S. midterm elections.

entries.title: Legal path seems narrow to challenge livestream of Fort Hood shooter's execution, experts say
entries.snippet: Broadcasting the event worldwide isn't mentioned in the Army rules governing how rare military executions are carried out. But that doesn't mean there is a viable legal path to oppose it by anyone besides Nidal Malik Hasan.

entries.title: WATCH LIVE: Graham set to debate Senate challengers Andrews, Whitener in South Carolina
entries.snippet: South Carolina Republican Sen. Darline Graham will face off in a debate Sunday against Democratic challenger Dr. Annie Andrews and Libertarian candidate Kasie Whitener.

entries.title: Ukraine: Zelenskyy accuses Russia of ceasefire violations
entries.snippet: Less than 24 hours after Donald Trump announced an "energy ceasefire," Ukraine reported Russian strikes on the northeastern city of Kharkiv. The Kremlin says it would only consider a one-day ceasefire for an election.

entries.title: Germany's Wadephul calls new EU sanctions 'unprecedented' blow to Russia
entries.snippet: The European Union has approved its largest-ever sanctions package against Moscow, targeting more than 1,000 entities tied to the military-industrial complex. The move took place in an EU foreign ministers' meeting.

entries.title: Saudi Arabia: Deadly Houthi strikes on Riyadh airport fuel fears of wider Middle East conflict
entries.snippet: Deadly Houthi attacks on Saudi airports have disrupted flights and raised fears of a wider regional conflict, as the US considers military action.

entries.title: Nobel Prize in Economics goes to pair of US economists
entries.snippet: Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford got the Nobel for developing economic models that help governments and central banks respond more effectively to booms and recessions.

entries.title: India news: Opposition parties march to Supreme Court
entries.snippet: Intensifying their demand for Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's resignation, opposition parties are holding a march to the Supreme Court. Follow DW for more.

entries.title: Germany's women: Ena Mahmutovic makes her case to become Germany's next No.1 goalkeeper
entries.snippet: Germany's win against Australia saw Ena Mahmutovic excel in goal. The 22-year-old Bayern Munich goalkeeper is considered the successor to Ann-Katrin Berger and is making a name for herself.

entries.title: Frankfurt Book Fair: Rights lawyer Sands awarded peace prize
entries.snippet: Franco-British lawyer and author Philippe Sands was awarded the German Book Trade's Peace Prize this weekend. Accepting the award, Sands criticized Germany's "inappropriate silence" regarding Israel.

entries.title: Germany news: Söder demands CDU supports of the AfD in Saxony-Anhalt reveal themselves
entries.snippet: Bavaria's conservative leader has called on bloc members who voted for an AfD parliamentary speaker to come forward. Meanwhile, the ruling coalition has been rocked by a major resignation. DW has more.

entries.title: How green is Europe's urban public transport? A data-driven reality check
entries.snippet: Greener buses and cleaner fleets are reshaping public transport across Europe. But are cities moving fast enough to meet their zero-emission goals?

entries.title: UK students call for school uniforms to be banned in pornography
entries.snippet: Short skirts, knee-high socks, white blouses: Girls' school uniform items are widely used as costumes in pornographic videos. As students experience harassment, a group wants to change that.

entries.title: Hurricane Simon batters Mexico's Pacific Coast
entries.snippet: Hurricane Simon is currently running parallel to Mexico's Pacific Coast, bringing heavy rainfall and strong winds to vulnerable towns.

entries.title: Germany: Bas quits as SPD co-chair amid coalition friction
entries.snippet: Bärbel Bas has resigned as labor minister and as co-leader of the Social Democrats as tension grows with Chancellor Merz's CDU.

entries.title: How Iran's elite forces 'mold the minds of the young cadets'
entries.snippet: Months of correspondence with two high-ranking defectors have given DW's investigative unit a rare look at the mindset of the regime's loyal servants — and revealed a clandestine circle that allegedly plots murders.

entries.title: US judge orders halt to taxpayer-funded promo ads of Trump
entries.snippet: Last week, President Donald Trump said he considered the ads to be a "positive promotion for our great USA." However, the New York district judge ruled that the commercials were an illegal misuse of funds.

entries.title: North Korea fires missiles after Seoul's hypersonic test
entries.snippet: North Korea has conducted its fourth missile launch in October. South Korea's military called this launch a "show of force" in response to South Korea's successful test launch of a hypersonic missile.

entries.title: Saudi Arabia: Second strike kills at least 1 at Riyadh airport
entries.snippet: Sunday's strike came as the King Khalid International Airport remained closed after a deadly attack on Saturday, and after a warning from Houthi rebels in Yemen that "worse is yet to come." Dammam airport was also hit.

entries.title: UK's Burnham accuses Russia of meddling in Brexit vote
entries.snippet: The UK prime minister called for voters in Europe to be made fully aware of Russia's attempts to influence politics.

entries.title: Air strikes kill dozens of gold miners on Sudan-Egypt border
entries.snippet: A Sudan-based rights group said 72 people were killed in a remote, disputed area known for illegal gold mining.

entries.title: Who are the Ukrainian 'volunteers' under Russian command?
entries.snippet: Russia has announced a battalion consisting of Ukrainian "volunteers." But veterans and former prisoners of war share very different accounts.
